text:
mia (sales): quick heads-up — Axion Health asked for a bespoke commercial on a 12mo commit. requesting 25% off hosted + dedicated, and later private deploy. theyre proposing $200k ARR (prefer prepay).
emma (revops): do we have expected monthly run-rate vs the commit? prepay vs monthly changes recognition. any professional services attach?
mia (sales): they expect ~60% traffic on hosted first 6mo then move to dedicated + private by Q4. small PS: two onboarding sprints.
nora (finance): 25% is steep. need margin calc and note on SLA/penalties. who covers support uplift cost?
mia (sales): support uplift TBD — customer wants 24x7 for launch month. i suggested a 15% support uplift to offset, they pushed back.
olivia (csm): onboarding estimate: ~2 engineers for 6 weeks (onboarding + validation). private migration adds handoff overhead. include that in cost-to-serve.
liam (eng): capacity note: we have headroom but Q4 private migrations could spike infra needs. reserved dedicated commit changes cost basis — we can offer deeper pricing if they take reserved GPU pool.
mia (sales): thinking of structured offer: option A = 18% off if they prepay annual + provide a case study + 12mo healthcare exclusivity; option B = 25% off only if they sign a 2yr reserved dedicated commit + private deploy. thoughts? :thinking_face:
emma (revops): that structure is reasonable. make case study a must for the deeper concession. I'll need a formal deal desk ticket to review.
mia (sales): filing it now — @dealbot please create approval packet.
dealbot: approval request D-4532 created — details: customer=Axion Health, ARR=$200,000, requested_discount=25%, proposed_offers=[18% prepay+case study, 25% 2yr reserved], reviewers=[emma (revops), nora (finance)].
nora (finance): provisional ok for 18% with prepay + case study and support uplift included. 25% requires full margin model + exec signoff; escalate to revops head.
emma (revops): @nora please paste required margin floor numbers and any disallowed concessions. Ill draft SLA/termination language to limit open credits.
mia (sales): thanks — i'll run both options with the buyer and push for option A. will update thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
olivia (csm): i'll prepare onboarding plan + cost estimate to attach to the packet.
liam (eng): ping me if they request early private ingestion tests; i can reserve a staging node for validation.
nora (finance): note for packet: cap credits for downtime at 6% annualized, require ticketing before any credit, and no credits for planned maintenance within agreed windows.
mia (sales): next steps: finalize margin calc, revops drafts legal clauses, csm attaches onboarding cost. target: close deal desk approval by EOD tomorrow.
